name: Rise of Empires
scope: Yes if it is the founding of a great empire
boundary: Rise of Empires owns each empire's founding; its rulers and later story stay with its own theme, such as The Roman Story, Mandate of Heaven, Sublime Porte or Peacock Throne.
example_beats: Sargon founds the Akkadian Empire (2334 BC)
Cyrus founds the Persian Empire (550 BC)
Chandragupta founds the Maurya Empire (322 BC)
Genghis Khan founds the Mongol Empire (1206)
notes: Date each empire to its founding or its founder's first conquest, one beat per empire, spread across every continent.
